title: NSTAR Electric Company d/b/a Eversource Energy (“the Company”) is filing herewith a petition with the Energy Facilities Siting Board pursuant to G.L. c. 40A, § 3 seeking individual and comprehensive zoning exemptions from the operation of the Town of Falmouth Zoning Bylaw in connection with the Company’s construction of a new transmission and bulk distribution substation on Company-owned land located at 228-280 Sam Turner Road in Falmouth, Massachusetts.
petitioner: NSTAR Electric Company and NSTAR Gas Company d/b/a Eversource Energy
